title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. In lieu of below fatwa we have asked the same two months earlier with Moulana/Mufti Anees Sb of chouhan bangar,Jafrabad & he told that " Ise Momool na banaye lekin jamat e sani agar kabhi kabhi karni ho to kar sakte hai, aur uske liye main mussallah chor kar kahi bhi jamat e sani kar sakte hai aur yeh jamat bina Ehqamat ke karni hogi, Imam bina takbeer ke niyat bandh le. Now please see above lines and clarify the same. Jaza kallah previously Asked: Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. If there is any shop, house or open place outside the main mosque where jamat is possible then it can be done there. and Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) Knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband 2286 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 158682 Country: India Title: I am in West Indies in jamat. It is a small Island and this Island is whole country approximate area of 110 km. We got the visa for 3 months but we will be moving in the country according to mashwira of local brothers. So are we musafir or muqim? Question: I am in West Indies in jamat. It is a small Island and this Island is whole country approximate area of 110 km. We got the visa for 3 months but we will be moving in the country according to mashwira of local brothers. So are we musafir or muqim? Answer ID: 158682 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 556/429/SD=5/1439) In the above mentioned case, if your stay is fixed in a particular city or village for fifteen days or more then you will become muqim, but if your stay is not fixed in a city or village for fifteen days for example, you intend to stay some days in some city or some days in some village or in two different cities or in various villages then in such a case you will be musafir . In order to become muqim it is mandatory that you intend to stay in one area whether it is a city or village for fifteen days. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
